Milestone Checks
Are any milestones missing?
Any missing entries in the following table must be fixed:

Coderedcap %>% filter(sitting == "Missing" | belly == "Missing" | crawl == "Missing" | cruise == "Missing" | walk == "Missing") %>% 
  select(id, session, all_of(cols))

  id session sitting   belly   crawl  cruise    walk

Are milestone dates consistent across visits?
✔ Yes, ✖ Never Observed, ❌ No (Needs to be Fixed)

Coderedcap %>% group_by(id) %>% summarize(Sit = n_distinct(sit_date, na.rm = T), Belly = n_distinct(belly_date, na.rm = T), Crawl = n_distinct(crawl_date, na.rm = T), Cruise = n_distinct(cruise_date, na.rm = T), Walk = n_distinct(walk_date, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  reactable( 
          filterable = TRUE, 
          compact = TRUE,
          striped = TRUE,
          defaultPageSize = 50,
          defaultSorted = c("id"),
          columns = list(
            id = colDef(format = colFormat(digits = 0), maxWidth = 50, align = "left"),
            Sit = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Belly = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Crawl = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Cruise = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Walk = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"})
            ))





Have infants acquired milestones by expected ages?
Session 1 (7 months)

Codesummarize_milestones <- function(s) {
  bind_cols(
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(sitting, name = "sitting_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(belly, name = "belly_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(crawl, name = "crawl_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(cruise, name = "cruise_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(walk, name = "walk_n", .drop = F)})
}
summarize_milestones(1)

  sitting sitting_n   belly belly_n   crawl crawl_n  cruise cruise_n    walk
1 Missing         0 Missing       0 Missing       0 Missing        1 Missing
2      No         5      No      17      No      19      No       21      No
3     Yes        18     Yes       6     Yes       4     Yes        1     Yes
  walk_n
1      1
2     22
3      0
